entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: Primal elder spell Nicol Bolas used to harvest planeswalker sparks for ultimate power and godhood.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who cast the Elderspell.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Invasion of Ravnica during which the Elderspell was cast.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane dropped into artificial night by the Elderspell.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: Planeswalker who recognized the Elderspell as primal, elder magic.

entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought off an Eternal by stealing the Elderspell from its mind.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Dreadhorde warriors empowered by the Elderspell to harvest sparks.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God-Eternal who bit Bolas and claimed all the sparks before exploding.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God-Eternal repelled and later obliterated by Bolas.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon sent flying by a strike of Bolas's wing.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God of Amonkhet whose spear impaled Bolas.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: Weapon that could have hurt Bolas had he not prepared against it.

entities.name: Spirit-Gem
entities.description: Mystic gem floating between Bolas's horns.

events.summary: Bolas casts the Elderspell after the Dreadhorde invades Ravnica, empowering the Eternals to harvest sparks.
events.quote: Bolas cast the Elderspell to grow his power by absorbing the sparks

events.summary: The Elderspell drops Ravnica into artificial night as stolen sparks rocket toward Bolas.
events.quote: dropping all of Ravnica into an artificial night

events.summary: Davriel Cane fights off an Eternal by stealing the Elderspell from its mind.
events.quote: Davriel Cane was able to fight off an Eternal by stealing the Elderspell from its mind

events.summary: Hundreds of planeswalkers are killed and their sparks harvested, making Bolas nearly invulnerable.
events.quote: Hundreds of planeswalkers were killed by Eternals

events.summary: Bolas repels Oketra and Bontu, obliterates Oketra, and sends Niv-Mizzet flying with a wing strike.
events.quote: later obliterate Oketra, with merely a thought

events.summary: Bontu bites Bolas, reversing the Elderspell's effects, and explodes; all stolen sparks disperse into the Aether.
events.quote: the God-Eternal Bontu bit Bolas, claiming all the sparks

relations.quote: The Elderspell is a spell that Nicol Bolas used during the War of the Spark to harvest planeswalker's sparks
the God-Eternal Bontu bit Bolas, claiming all the sparks
later obliterate Oketra, with merely a thought
